statement: I build software that has to keep working, across distributed systems, security, and applied AI.

chooser.heading: What brought you here?
chooser.intro: Choose a path. Each one opens a page curated for that reader, with the details everyone else can skip.

items.label: Writing
items.text: “The Real Cost of AI Code Shows Up 30 Days Later,” published by BLOG@CACM on Nov 4, 2026.

items.label: Judging
items.text: Mentor and judge at HackMIT 2026, one of a 12-judge panel at Frontier Cascadia, and a core judge for the USAII Global AI Hackathon, which drew teams from 90+ countries.

items.label: Production
items.text: A high-throughput Amazon system handling 500K+ requests per second across 5 external APIs, improving SLA adherence by 22%.

items.label: Open source
items.text: Agent Skills, an MIT-licensed collection of reusable AI agent skills, including distributed-systems design review and zero-downtime migration.
